blocks.text: BUNIA, DR Congo—Attacks by gunmen linked to the Islamic State group have left at least 44 civilians dead in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo this week, humanitarian and security sources told AFP on Friday. The latest raids in the northeastern Ituri province by the Allied Democratic Forces come just days after the notoriously brutal group killed 66 people, including three health workers fighting the region’s spiralling Ebola epidemic, in an attack in neighboring North Kivu.
